# Draft:Internet Vikings

----
}}
Internet Vikings is a Swedish technology company that provides hosting services for the iGaming and sports betting industries, specializing in services for regulated markets. It was founded in 2008 by Rickard Vikström and Victor Jerlin. The company operates hosting infrastructure in data centers in the United States, Europe, and Canada, and is certified under the ISO 27001 information security standard.
History
Internet Vikings was established in Stockholm in 2008 as a provider of search engine optimization (SEO) hosting. The company later shifted its focus toward hosting services for licensed operators in iGaming and sports betting.
In 2019, Jesper Kärrbrink, former chief executive of Mr Green, became chairman of the board. That year, the company also acquired Costa PBN, an SEO content provider.
In 2021, Internet Vikings entered the United States market, establishing operations in states such as New Jersey, Michigan, Colorado, and West Virginia.
In 2025, the company expanded its European presence by launching hosting infrastructure in Belgium.
According to industry coverage, the company positions itself as a specialized hosting provider focused on the iGaming sector, emphasizing cost efficiency and independence between data center locations.
Services and locations
Internet Vikings provides hosting services, including cloud hosting, bare metal servers, co-location hosting, and disaster recovery.
The company operates data centers in the United States, Canada, Sweden, Malta, the Netherlands, and Belgium.
Recognition
Industry organizations have recognized the company through awards, including:
* 2022: Global Gaming Awards – Services Provider of the Year
* 2024: EGR North America Awards – Cloud and IT Services Partner of the Year
